members.name: crypto-service
members.purpose: 18 npm packages: crypto-lib, crypto-server (REST API), CLI, TypeScript SDK, framework and ORM integrations, KMS, MCP and LSP servers.

members.name: crypto-service-sdk-java
members.purpose: Async-first Java client (CompletableFuture) for the crypto-server REST API.

members.name: crypto-service-sdk-rust
members.purpose: Async-first Rust client (tokio, optional blocking feature) for the crypto-server REST API.

members.name: crypto-service-sdk-go
members.purpose: Go client (context.Context, safe for concurrent use) for the crypto-server REST API.

members.name: crypto-service-sdk-cpp
members.purpose: C++17 client (std::future async client and blocking client) for the crypto-server REST API.

members.name: crypto-service-sdk-dotnet
members.purpose: Async .NET client (Task, CancellationToken) for the crypto-server REST API.

members.name: crypto-service-sdk-python
members.purpose: Async-first Python client (asyncio and sync) for the crypto-server REST API.
